summary: Re-tested live backend and mobile web screening flows. Backend regression passed 4/4; normal Grade 0 and NPDR Grade 2 results rendered. Results-to-upload navigation still leaves two upload-screen nodes, and clipboard export did not confirm success.

integration_issues.issue: After tapping scan-another, URL becomes /upload but DOM contains 2 upload-screen nodes instead of one.
Export button is tappable, but browser clipboard write fails with NotAllowedError and button remains SHARE / EXPORT SUMMARY CARD; no user-facing failure message is shown.

action_items: Fix Expo Router stack/route retention so Scan another image mounts exactly one upload screen.
Provide a user-visible fallback/error for clipboard permission failure, or use a supported share/download flow.
Align retinaApi.ts with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; current code reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while frontend/.env does not define EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
Remove the DB_NAME default fallback in server.py if strict fail-fast is required for all protected environment variables.
critical_code_review_comments: Live API is not mocked for tested flows; backend persisted screening records in MongoDB.
retinaApi.ts contains a local sample fallback path, which is a MOCKED/FALLBACK path when /api/samples fails.
Expo logs include a React Native DevTools Electron sandbox warning, but Metro bundles and the app renders.
seed_data_creation: Created live screening records through normal and NPDR sample prediction requests; no seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and both curated sample result paths pass. Recheck DOM count after Scan another, then test export with clipboard permissions and verify a success or failure state.
rca_of_issue: The results handler calls clearSelection() followed by router.navigate('/upload'). The URL changes correctly, but Expo Router retains the prior upload route tree and produces two upload-screen testID nodes. Export uses navigator.clipboard.writeText on web; the preview denies clipboard permission, the catch only logs a warning, and copied state is never set.
